definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. kank, n; kank-yrði gibes; kankast to jeer, gibe; cank to talk of anything, to cackle, Halliwell : Scot. cangle to quarrel.

source_text: ge-canc, es; n. [?] A mock, gibe; ludibrium, vituperium, Som : Hpt. Gl. 441, 510. [Cf. Icel. kank, n; kank-yrði gibes; kankast to jeer, gibe; cank to talk of anything, to cackle, Halliwell : Scot. cangle to quarrel.]
